Batch 17 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 17 resolves 13 historical broadcast recordings across two enduring American radio traditions: Freeman Gosden and Charles Correll's landmark comedy series Amos 'n' Andy (including wartime Rinso-sponsored episodes featuring guest stars Robert Benchley and Frank Morgan, plus rare 1930 and 1949 audition master discs) and 1946 syndicated transcription discs of western vocal masters Foy Willing And The Riders Of The Purple Sage.

1. Amos 'n' Andy — NBC Master Runs & Historic Discs Dated

Created, written, and voiced by Freeman Gosden and Charles Correll:

Amos_Andy_Promo_Billy_Murray.mp3 "Perfect Record 12597: Billy Murray & Walter Scanlon Amos 'n' Andy Promo" 1930-04-15 Rare 1930 Brunswick/Perfect promotional record featuring Billy Murray.
